The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: In Maharashtra’s Marathwada region, child marriage persists as families grapple with fears over girls’ safety and so-called honour. Poverty and migration add to the problem, while predators, weak institutions, and a marriage market deepen their vulnerability. Radheshyam Jadhav follows girls and women caught in this cycle and those fighting to break it through education and independence

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Consent forms, notices, prison terms: Maharashtra anti-conversion law | Explained
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Maharashtra’s law aiming to curb forced conversion has created unease among minority communities and those in interfaith relationship who fear the new Act can be used against them

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Congress claims tribal students headed for Mumbai protest detained; condemns action
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The students, who were seeking the resignation of the tribal development minister and the department's commissioner, were threatened with police cases and a bus carrying them was taken into custody, the Congress claimed.

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Eating out in Mumbai to get costlier as restaurants plan 10–15% menu price hike
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: AHAR cites rising cooking gas prices, food costs, rentals and wages; revised rates likely to be introduced in the coming weeks

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra FDA resolves 72% of 13,857 complaints in three months; AI filters out over 11,000 invalid submissions
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Pune records highest number of grievances, while complaints against dark stores and quick-commerce platforms rise

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Two men arrested in Navi Mumbai for duping investors through fake iridium scheme
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The accused claimed iridium reserves were available along the West Bengal-Bangladesh border and that the Centre had agreed to purchase it for ₹3.34 lakh crore; they promised to distribute 50% of proceeds among the investors

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Congress names candidates for 3 Maharashtra MLC seats
Maharashtra SIR: Lists of ‘logical discrepancies’, ‘unmapped persons’ yet to be published
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Sources in the CEO’s office say process of publication is ongoing at ERO level, without offering any timeframe for its completion; claims and objections window open till October 26

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra declares 40 more talukas drought-hit, announces ₹5,000 aid for farmers
Maharashtra FDA bans loose spice powder sales, orders Statewide crackdown on adulteration
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The Food Safety Commissioner’s order bans prohibited colouring agents, including Metanil Yellow and Rhodamine B, and adulterants such as brick powder and chalk, and requires all spice powders to be packed and sealed at the place of production before sale

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Congress names candidates for Maharashtra MLC polls
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The party renominated MLC Abhijit Wanjari for the constituency for Graduates of Nagpur Division, and member Jayant Dinkar Asagaonkar for the seat for Teachers of Pune Division. The party fielded Aditi Pohare for the constituency for Teachers of Amravati.

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Amid ongoing protest, BMC approves 180 days of paid maternity leave for outsourced women health workers
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The workers have been protesting at Azad Maidan for the past several days, demanding improved working conditions, timely payment of salaries, revised minimum wages and maternity benefits

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Anti-CEC protest: Actor Imran Khan issued notice, asked to leave India by October 28
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Action against Imran Khan has been initiated under Section 7 of the Immigration and Foreigners Act, senior officials told The Hindu; the action comes after the actor participated in anti-CEC protest in Mumbai’s August Kranti Maidan on October 10, where protesters demanded the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Tata Trusts row: Noel, son Neville Tata move Bombay HC and Mumbai civil court with caveats
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Both the father and son moved the courts with their caveats on October 7, as per official records

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Pune to suspend water supply every Thursday from October 15
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: PMC has pointed out that in the Khadakwasla dam, which provides water to Pune, as of October 12, water storage is less compared to the available water storage every year

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Thane Police bust matrimonial fraud racket, arrest two men; ₹14.25 lakh cash, 311 grams of gold seized
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The accused have been identified as Dinesh Babu Manekar (39), a resident of Mahape in Navi Mumbai, and his alleged accomplice Suresh alias Babu Tanaji Mhatre (55), a resident of Chikhali in Raigad district

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Education Ministry forms panel to investigate student’s death at IIIT Ranchi
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The Committee has been mandated to examine the circumstances surrounding the incident

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: The grief of ghungroos
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Maharashtra’s Kolhati women preserve the State’s Tamasha folk tradition even as many face sexual exploitation, financial insecurity and social stigma, and their children are denied access to education and a chance to choose better future. Radheshyam Jadhav explores how community members and activists are working to break this intergenerational cycle of exploitation while preserving their cultural heritage

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Sahil Wakode death: Parents demand arrest of IIT Bombay professors as student groups protest at Azad Maidan
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The protesters demanded action against Suryanarayana Doolla, Professor of Energy Science and Engineering, and Professor Shireesh B. Kedare, Director of IIT Bombay, along with a transparent investigation and stronger safeguards against caste discrimination

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: BMC removes over 52,000 unauthorised banners, posters in Mumbai since January
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: During a special drive, between October 8 and 16, the BMC seized around 3,537 unauthorised advertisements, including banners, boards, posters and flags in Mumba

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Actor Tiger Shroff escapes firing attempt in Mumbai’s Juhu; manhunt launched for perpetrators
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: According to a viral social media post, the Lawrence Bishnoi gang has claimed responsibility for the attack, but police are yet to verify its authenticity
